contract.core: readRows returns null (not []) for any ledger candidate it did not actually read, and readOffloadRows treats a repository as measured only when at least one of its own <checkout>/.mikro/runs/*.jsonl files was actually read, so a directory-only ledger yields null while a readable empty ledger yields a measured 0.

acceptanceCriteria: readRows in src/lib/metrics-offload.ts returns null, not an empty row array, for every candidate whose readFileSync did not actually read it — absent (ENOENT/ENOTDIR), a directory (EISDIR), or any thrown read error. Falsified if any non-reading branch of readRows still resolves to [] / an empty rows array.

readOffloadRows in src/lib/metrics-offload.ts no longer lets a merely-named own ledger candidate establish measurement: a repository whose only <checkout>/.mikro/runs/*.jsonl entry is a directory returns null (no ledger), never a measured 0. Falsified if the measurement predicate still counts candidates by name (e.g. ownFiles.length > 0) or if such a repository reports attempts 0 / tokens 0 instead of null.

A readable empty ledger file is still a measured 0: readRows returns an empty array only for a file it actually read, so a repository with a readable empty *.jsonl ledger reports attempts 0 and tokens 0. Falsified if a readable empty ledger yields null.

The #3125 guard is preserved: a non-absent read failure (not ENOENT/ENOTDIR/EISDIR) still makes the repository unknown/null rather than a measured 0 or a partial total. Falsified if a non-absent read failure produces a measured 0 or a partial total.

src/lib/metrics-export.test.ts adds a regression that asserts a directory-only ledger yields null and a readable empty ledger yields a measured 0, and that regression fails on the pre-change readRows/readOffloadRows behavior. Falsified if no assertion covers the directory-only → null case, or if the added test would still pass under the unchanged name-only measured predicate.

findings.claim: Met. ownFiles is only iterated (lines 154-159); ownRead flips true only after readRows returns non-null, and the terminal predicate is `return ownRead || kept.length > 0 ? kept : null;` (line 173), which never consults ownFiles.length. A runs dir whose only *.jsonl entry is a directory (readFileSync throws EISDIR -> isAbsent true -> null, unreadable untouched) leaves ownRead=false and kept=[], so readOffloadRows returns null; buildIntervals assigns that null to interval.offload (metrics-export.ts:217).
findings.provenance: src/lib/metrics-offload.ts:152-159,173; confirmed by read of src/lib/metrics-export.ts:182-186,214-218

findings.criterion: A readable empty ledger file is still a measured 0: readRows returns an empty array only for a file it actually read, so a repository with a readable empty *.jsonl ledger reports attempts 0 and tokens 0. Falsified if a readable empty ledger yields null.
findings.claim: Met. A successful readFileSync of an empty file yields rows=[] and returns it (line 109), not null; readOffloadRows then sets ownRead=true (lines 155-158) and returns kept=[] via line 173. offloadInWindow([], ...) computes attempts 0, failed 0, ambiguous 0, tokens 0, costUsd 0 — exactly the object the regression asserts.

findings.criterion: The #3125 guard is preserved: a non-absent read failure (not ENOENT/ENOTDIR/EISDIR) still makes the repository unknown/null rather than a measured 0 or a partial total. Falsified if a non-absent read failure produces a measured 0 or a partial total.
findings.claim: Met. isAbsent still covers only ENOENT/ENOTDIR/EISDIR (lines 65-69); any other failure sets seen.unreadable=true (line 86 in readRows; also line 75 in listDir and line 134 in repoCheckouts), and line 171 `if (seen.unreadable) return null;` executes before the ownRead/kept return, so the unreadable signal outranks any readable partial total. The retained parent test at metrics-export.test.ts:406-466 still pins this (EACCES cases at lines 426, 429, 439, 448, 454).

findings.criterion: src/lib/metrics-export.test.ts adds a regression that asserts a directory-only ledger yields null and a readable empty ledger yields a measured 0, and that regression fails on the pre-change readRows/readOffloadRows behavior. Falsified if no assertion covers the directory-only -> null case, or if the added test would still pass under the unchanged name-only measured predicate.
findings.claim: Met. The added test (metrics-export.test.ts:468-484) first creates only a directory named wish-context.jsonl under <root>/repo/.mikro/runs and asserts `expect(offload()).toBeNull()` (line 480), then writes an empty readable review-prep.jsonl and asserts toEqual({attempts:0,failed:0,ambiguous:0,tokens:0,costUsd:0}) (line 483). Under the parent revision the diff shows readRows returned [] on the EISDIR catch and the predicate was `rows.length > 0 || ownFiles.length > 0`, so the directory alone set ownFiles.length=1 and readOffloadRows returned [] -> a measured-0 offload object, making line 480's toBeNull() fail. The test thus fails on pre-change behavior; GENIE_HOME is isolated to <root>/genie (test lines 25-26) so no machine ledger can make the first assertion pass for the wrong reason.
